rule.name: Clean Linux OS Version
rule.comment:
/(SUSE|SunOS|Red Hat|CentOS|Ubuntu|Debian|Fedora|AlmaLinux|Oracle)(?:\D+|)([\d.]+) ?(?:\(?([\w ]+)\)?)?/
Example : Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS -> #1 = 22.04.1 SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 11 (x86_64) -> #1 = 11 SunOS 5.10 -> #1 = 5.10 Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server release 7.9 (Maipo) -> #1 = 7.9 Oracle Linux Server release 7.3 -> #1 = 7.3 Fedora release 36 (Thirty Six) -> #1 = 36 Debian GNU/Linux 9.5 (stretch) -> #1 = 9.5 CentOS release 6.9 (Final) -> #1 = 6.9 AlmaLinux 9.0 (Emerald Puma) -> #1 = 9.0

rule.name: Clean Windows OS Version
rule.comment:
/(Microsoft)(?>\(R\)|®)? (Windows) (XP|\d\.\d|\d{1,4}|Vista)(™)? ?(.*)/
Example : Microsoft Windows XP Professionnel -> #2 : XP Microsoft Windows 7 Enterprise -> #2 : 7 Microsoft® Windows Vista Professionnel -> #2 : Vista Microsoft Windows XP Édition familiale -> #2 : XP Microsoft Windows 10 Entreprise -> #2 : 10 Microsoft Windows 10 Professionnel -> #2 : 10 Microsoft Windows 11 Professionnel -> #2 : 11

rule.name: Clean Windows Server OS Version
rule.comment:
/(Microsoft)(?>\(R\)|®)? (?:(Hyper-V|Windows)(?:\(R\))?) ((?:Server|))(?:\(R\)|®)? (\d{4}(?: R2)?)(?:[,\s]++)?([^\s]*)(?: Edition(?: x64)?)?$/
Example : Microsoft Windows Server 2012 R2 Datacenter -> #3 : 2012 R2 Microsoft(R) Windows(R) Server 2003, Standard Edition x64 -> #3 : 2003 Microsoft Hyper-V Server 2012 R2 -> #3 : 2012 R2 Microsoft® Windows Server® 2008 Standard -> #3 : 2008

rule.name: TECLIB - Mac OS X
rule.comment: Supprimer le numéro de build du nom de version de l'OS
